title: Extend Dependabot docker updates to cover deploy/aws so the digest pins stay current
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server/.github/dependabot.yml, the docker entry covers only `directory: "/"`. Change it to `directories: ["/", "/deploy/aws"]`, or add a second docker entry for "/deploy/aws", keeping `interval: weekly`. Dependabot then opens reviewed PRs that bump the pinned node:24-alpine digest in both Dockerfiles, so the pin does not freeze the base image and miss Alpine or Node security fixes. Merge through the normal PR process with 1 approval. This change does not touch runtime images.
acceptanceCriteria: `.github/dependabot.yml` on main has a `package-ecosystem: "docker"` update whose directories include both "/" and "/deploy/aws"
The repository's Dependabot page (Insights > Dependency graph > Dependabot) lists both Dockerfile and deploy/aws/Dockerfile as monitored manifests with a last check that ran without error

verificationMethod.description: Review the merged dependabot.yml diff and confirm that the docker ecosystem entry lists "/deploy/aws" in addition to "/". Then open the GitHub Dependabot status for mongodb-mcp-server and confirm deploy/aws/Dockerfile is monitored with no configuration error.

rootCause.description: Dependabot's docker ecosystem is scoped only to the repository root, so deploy/aws/Dockerfile gets no automated base-image update PRs. A digest pin there would go stale with nobody notified.
